collection.title: VW Passat Saloon 2012 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a VW Passat Saloon 2012 to 2014 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
